query:
SELECT 
  c.searchId,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.productImages IS NOT NULL AND c.productImages != '' AND c.productImages != '[]' AND c.productImages != 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_product_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.productImages IS NULL OR c.productImages = '' OR c.productImages = '[]' OR c.productImages = 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_product_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.urgencyImages IS NOT NULL AND c.urgencyImages != '' AND c.urgencyImages != '[]' AND c.urgencyImages != 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_urgency_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.urgencyImages IS NULL OR c.urgencyImages = '' OR c.urgencyImages = '[]' OR c.urgencyImages = 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_urgency_images
FROM companies c
WHERE c.searchId IN (1500003, 1350004)
GROUP BY c.searchId;
